evidence.testTitle: matrix user gaps delivers REST profile updates to subscribed shared-channel IRC peers
evidence.scenarioScope: REST profile update and IRC notifications
evidence.rationale: Assertions are limited to the concrete behavior described; unasserted required dimensions remain open.
assertionDetails: A subscribed shared-channel peer receives display name, avatar and status; a second account device receives display name; nonshared and unsubscribed clients receive no display-name marker before barriers.
A cross-user avatar write is denied without a notification or target change; owner clear produces 766; stopped SQLite and fresh Bob login after restart confirm persisted fields.

This test does NOT snapshot/re-read an unrelated account profile before and after mutation. Outsider notification silence counts as events only; unrelated persistent-resource proof is supplied, if accepted, by the separately named current09 identity case.
